text_blocks.snippet: Aortic valve stenosis (AS) is a condition where the aortic valve does not open fully, restricting blood flow from the heart to the body. Symptoms of AS may include:

list.snippet: Shortness of breath, especially during exertion

text_blocks.snippet: Swelling in the feet or ankles, Palpitations (feeling your heartbeat), Cough, and Wheezing.

AS typically progresses gradually over time. Symptoms may worsen as the stenosis becomes more severe. In severe cases, AS can lead to significant limitations in daily activities and an increased risk of heart failure.
